query.text: 请陪我处理就医相关的事情，我向你提问时请结合现场信息回答。
query.text_en: Please assist me with matters related to my medical visit and answer my questions using the scene information.

annotation.text_zh: 请把药盒正面靠近镜头，我帮您确认。
annotation.text_en: Hold the front of the medicine box closer to the camera so I can check it.

assistant_role_basis: 按任务归类，不代表可从画面确认设备硬件
